title: Free Community Microchipping Day
location: Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP
description: Layton Community House and Longview Animal Centre (your local independent RSPCA branch) are working together to help local pet owners keep their cats and dogs safe. Saturday 17 October, 10am–3pm at Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP. Microchipping is quick and simple, and gives your pet the best chance of being reunited with you if they ever go missing – it's also now a legal requirement. No appointment needed, just come along. Please bring cats in a secure carrier and keep dogs on a secure lead. Layton Community House on Facebook →

title: Evening Silent Disco: Blooms & Beats Walk
location: Meet at Layton Methodist Church, walk around Layton
description: Grab your headphones and join us for an evening walking silent disco around Layton! Dance through the streets as the sun goes down, each walker moving to their own soundtrack, in a fun and friendly atmosphere. Meet at Layton Methodist Church for the start of the walk. This event is part of Pride in Place Layton, brought to you in partnership with Wandering Women and Nurturefy. Friday 2 October, 7:00pm. Meeting point: Layton Methodist Church All adults welcome. Free to attend, but booking is required. Book your place →

title: Pride in Place Layton: Community Party

title: Country & Western Themed Lunch Club
description: Saddle up and join us for a rootin' tootin' afternoon of good food, fun, laughter and great company at our Country & Western Lunch Club! £4 per person: 2-course meal, tea & coffee, bingo, guess the song, fun quiz. Optional fancy dress! Thursday 24 September, 12:30pm at At The Grange . £4 per person. Everyone welcome.

title: Lightpool 2026: Welcoming Winter at the Field of Dreams
location: Field of Dreams, Bowness Ave, Blackpool, FY4 4TE
description: Artist Ivan Morison worked in the field to turn the harvested crop into a series of sculptures, coated in sand and lime – creatures that will look after the meadow over winter. This Lightpool, help welcome these field creatures to the land, with an evening of unexpected light from artists AndNow. Friday 23 October, 6:30pm-8pm at the Field of Dreams. Free. Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England. Under 14s must be accompanied by an adult.

title: Community Harvest Supper Club
description: Enjoy a meal together made with traditional harvest recipes, as we set intentions for the field through song with Lancashire folk artist Jennifer Reid. Friday 2 October, 4pm-6pm at the Field of Dreams. Free, but spaces are limited – book your place by emailing info@leftcoast.org.uk . Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England.

title: Creative Harvest Activities
description: Watch the field being hand cut by Groundwork and volunteers at 10am, or have a go yourself in a training session led by scything trainer Steve Tomlin. From 11am-4pm, drop in for creative activities inspired by the field: make a corn dolly, mix homemade plant remedies, or create a wild clay drinking beaker. Saturday 3 October, 10am-4pm at the Field of Dreams. Free, drop in any time. Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England.

title: Family Film Day at the Field of Dreams
description: Films shown in the festival marquee, with popcorn and snacks. Relaxed showing (U): 11am. Second showing (PG): 2pm. Sunday 4 October at the Field of Dreams. Free. Under 14s must be accompanied by an adult. Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England.

title: Speed Quiz at Cask Layton
location: Cask Layton, 9 Layton Road, Blackpool, FY3 8EA
description: A free-to-enter speed quiz using the SpeedQuizzing app – no pens, no paper, no cheating. Just bring a smartphone or tablet (one device per team, no wifi or data needed). 1st prize: £20 voucher, 2nd prize: £10 voucher. There's also an optional music bingo round – £1 a card, with a cash prize. Wednesday 30 September, 8pm at Cask Layton. Cask Micropub on Facebook →

title: Layton Cemetery Heritage Tours
location: Layton Cemetery — meet at the Lodge/main gates
description: As it's Heritage Week, Friends of Layton Cemetery are offering two tours of Layton Cemetery's Victorian burial ground. Meet at the Lodge/main gates.
